state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place) is under way.** Stage 3 is done: `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal in front of `goal-closeout`.

`benches/serve-proxied.json` now holds two rows recorded at `596460142`: the fair arm on one cpu and the deployed arm on four. Direct `nvs serve` goes from about 41k to 84k requests per second. Behind nginx it stays near 40k on both budgets, so the proxy and not `nvs serve` bounds the shipped ratio on four cpus. `bun nv bench-proxied` rebuilds the image on every run (`up` in `tools/nv/cmd/bench-proxied.ts`), and `benches/proxied/Dockerfile.dockerignore` sends the docs the build compiles in. Gap `serve-proxied-was-never-recorded-on-four-cores` is deleted.

The `nvs-diagnostics`, `benches`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-db`, `nvs-ir`, `nvs-config` and `nvs-server` gap directories are closed for this goal. One `nvs-syntax` gap is left, `the-pipeline-bench-has-no-nested-twin`, a bench member in a different file set.

In `nvs-cli`, one gap names this goal, and the other subcommands' `--help` text has not been swept and is still in the dense voice.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes (module doc of `tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`). A person has to push, so no session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest of the gaps across many crates: `nvs-host` (4), `nvs-lsp` (5), `nvs-runtime` and `nvs-stdlib` the largest. Stage 4 stops on `BLOCKED` only for "too large", as the goal's § *Stage 4* defines it. `bun nv import` is broken because the rule index it reads was deleted. Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6, as expected.

The `--max-work-ms 6` budget at `tools/nv/cmd/bench.ts:445` is absolute and has about 0.1 ms of room on an idle development machine (goal `ci-green`'s backlog), so a hosted runner may fail it: decide its CI form in the step's comment.
